metadata.title: Orbital Hydroponics: O2 Yield and Biomass Cycling
metadata.subtitle: Closed-Loop Life Support Matrices in Microgravity
metadata.author: LexaWrites Press

glossary.O2_req: Daily oxygen requirement per crew member (kg)
glossary.Y_plant: Daily oxygen yield per square meter of crop canopy (kg/m2)
glossary.W_transpiration: Daily water recycled via canopy transpiration (L)

chapters.title: System Variables and Baseline Respiration Constants
chapters.focus: Define O2_req, N_crew, Y_plant, and A_cultivation constraints.

chapters.title: Photoperiod Mechanics and Canopy Energy Transfer
chapters.focus: Detail the 16-hour light cycle and its effect on initial seedling transpiration.

chapters.title: Early Cultivation Geometry and Yield Deficits
chapters.focus: Model canopy_coverage_m2 expansion from Day 1 to Day 14 against the 0.05 yield constant.

chapters.title: Mid-Cycle Gas Exchange and Deficit Mitigation
chapters.focus: Trace O2_produced_kg and net_O2_deficit_kg trends across Day 21 and Day 28.

chapters.title: Terminal Area Constraints and Output Optimization
chapters.focus: Analyze the peak 120 m2 canopy footprint reached on Day 35.

chapters.title: Cumulative Water Draw and Transpiration Auditing
chapters.focus: Synthesize the 35-day water_consumed_L matrix against the 2500 L reservoir limits.

chapters.title: Operational Surplus Thresholds and System Autonomy
chapters.focus: Audit the 0.96 kg net O2 surplus achieved at maximum hardware capacity.
